Old regression file /app/backend/tests/test_agent_storage_regression.py still contains obsolete expectations from deprecated Agent Studio behavior; avoid using it as current correction truth source.

rca of the issue: Repro for routing bug: open https://pulse-ai-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/token/FARTCOIN -> page renders error 'Token Hub not found.' because route currently expects mint address values and directly calls /api/tokens/{address}. No symbol->mint canonical mapping exists in the current route/data fetch path. Mitigation: add explicit symbol alias resolution for canonical token (or update requirement/docs and links to mint-only canonical route consistently).
